r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.
r0-context.finding: Loaded handoff (g3-review-handoff.md), test file, curate_corpus.py source, and implementer report (g3-implement-result.md).

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: tests/test_curate_corpus.py (new) delivers exactly the golden-fixture suite the g3 gate asked for: 18 tests, one class per detector, proving each detector bites plus a flags-never-gates falsification.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r2-scope.finding: git status --short shows only '?? tests/test_curate_corpus.py'. curate_corpus.py and every real skill untouched.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Reproduced: py -m pytest tests/test_curate_corpus.py -v -> 18 passed; py -m pytest tests/ -q -> 464 passed, 2 skipped. Matches implementer's report exactly.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Stdlib+unittest only, no new deps; assertions read exact status/check strings from cc constants (SHINGLE_SIZE, SKILL_WORD_TARGET, REFERENCE_TOC_LINE_THRESHOLD, CONFUSABLE_SKILLS) rather than guessed literals, so drift in the tool's vocabulary would fail the suite, not silently mismatch.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: Test-only addition to an existing G1 tool; no architecture/contract change. No reconciliation needed.

r6-fixture-provenance.title: Fixture provenance (T6)
r6-fixture-provenance.imperative: Confirm planted DUPLICATION strings are verbatim from commit 2696769 via git show.
r6-fixture-provenance.finding: Reproduced independently: git show 2696769:skills/implementer/SKILL.md | grep misfit -> line 10 matches COMPLIANCE_BOILERPLATE verbatim. git show 2696769:skills/commander/SKILL.md | grep 'FOLLOW THIS SKILL STRICTLY' -> line 8 matches EMPHATIC_BANNER verbatim. git show 2696769:skills/workbench/SKILL.md | grep checklist_engine.py -> line 39 contains ENGINE_INVOCATION verbatim as a substring. All three planted duplication strings are authentic pre-#108 text, not invented.

r7-detector-coverage.title: Every detector has a BITING assertion
r7-detector-coverage.imperative: Confirm duplication, size, invoker (both dirs), description checks, reference-toc, parse each assert exact status/check strings.
r7-detector-coverage.finding: Confirmed every detector has a biting test with exact-string assertions: duplication (test_duplication_bites_two_authentic_signatures + ignores_a_single_planting + emphatic_banner boundary case), size (oversized flagged / within-budget ok), invoker both directions (missing flagged / present ok), description-person (shortlist, not verdict), description-when-to-use (flagged), description-exclusion both directions using real CONFUSABLE_SKILLS names scout/cartographer (flagged/info) + nonconfusable no-finding, reference-toc (flagged/no-flag), parse (flagged rows for malformed SKILL.md and missing SKILL.md, no crash, main still exits 0).

r8-flags-never-gates.title: Flags-never-gates falsification is real
r8-flags-never-gates.imperative: Confirm maximally-flagged fixture triggers every detector BEFORE asserting exit 0.
r8-flags-never-gates.finding: test_maximally_flagged_fixture_still_exits_zero asserts flagged_checks (a set built from actual curate() findings) contains all 8 expected checks (size, invoker, description-length, description-when-to-use, description-exclusion, reference-toc, duplication, parse) PLUS an assertion that some finding is shortlist, BEFORE the exit-0 assertions (cc.main([...])==0 and with --json). This ordering means the invariant assertion cannot pass vacuously -- if the fixture failed to trip a detector, the preceding assertIn would fail first.

r9-non-tautology-spotcheck.title: Non-tautology spot-check
r9-non-tautology-spotcheck.imperative: Break one detector or flip one expected string in a throwaway copy; confirm a golden assertion REDS; revert.
r9-non-tautology-spotcheck.finding: Performed spot-check myself: copied tests/test_curate_corpus.py to a throwaway tests/_spotcheck_test_curate_corpus.py, flipped the expected status in test_missing_invoker_flagged from ['flagged'] to ['ok']. Ran py -m pytest tests/_spotcheck_test_curate_corpus.py -v -k test_missing_invoker_flagged -> FAILED with AssertionError: Lists differ: ['flagged'] != ['ok'] (real tool still reports 'flagged', proving the assertion is load-bearing, not tautological). Deleted the throwaway copy immediately after. Verified afterward: git status --short shows only the original '?? tests/test_curate_corpus.py'; re-ran py -m pytest tests/test_curate_corpus.py -q -> 18 passed. Tool and real test file unchanged.

r10-green.title: Green - full suite
r10-green.imperative: Run pytest tests/test_curate_corpus.py -v and pytest tests/ -q; confirm all pass.
r10-green.finding: py -m pytest tests/test_curate_corpus.py -v -> 18 passed in 0.33-0.43s. py -m pytest tests/ -q -> 464 passed, 2 skipped, 150 subtests passed. No failures, no new skips introduced by this suite.

consolidation.summary: All 11 checks pass. Fixture provenance reproduced via independent git show; every detector has a biting exact-string assertion; flags-never-gates falsification is non-vacuous (asserts flags present before exit-0); reviewer-performed non-tautology spot-check (flipped expected string in throwaway copy) reds as expected and was discarded; full suite green; scope limited to the one new test file.
